remaining.summary: The wider transcription check passed 158 Web/WASM tests and 9 Rust tests, but existing argument-style lint errors in commands.ts prevent it from being green. The scoped check covers the changed path.
The local production package was not rebuilt for this UI change.

resolution.summary: Redesigned the English Batch dialog and exposed pinned browser transcription models in Batch and scene automation. Chrome verified the dialog at 1134px and 390px and produced 16 timed English words and 40 timed Hebrew words. The selected recipe and canonical checkpoint preserve the model on resume.
